domain_hint: UAV aluminum payload bracket FEA with bolt preload, contact, and modal checks
ambiguity_notes:
- Boundary conditions conflict: slides claim encastre pads while noting spring supports and test bushings; validation comparison mixes these.
- Material model inconsistency: base case stated as linear elastic; notes indicate bilinear plasticity may have been active in Rev B runs.
- Contact treatment varies across mesh levels (bonded vs frictional), undermining the refinement claims.
- Solver convergence criteria contradictory (1e-6 vs 1e-4 accepted), affecting result credibility.
- Validation error claimed <5% while comparisons are scaled from 10 kN to a 12.5 kN test and do not match the actual setup.
- Geometric detail inconsistency: R2 fillets said to be included, then suppressed by cleanup script in the same hot-spot area.
